params.attestedSeconds: Seconds to attest; must be <= maxSeconds.

params.usdc_: ERC-20 token address; must be non-zero and have 6 decimals.

params.hourlyRate: USDC 6-decimal units per hour; must be in (0, MAX_HOURLY_RATE].
params.maxSeconds: Maximum shift duration in seconds; must be in (0, MAX_SHIFT_SECONDS].
params.worker: Address of the worker; must be non-zero and != msg.sender.

MAX_ESCROW().notice: Maximum escrow per shift (10,000 USDC, 6-decimal units).

MAX_HOURLY_RATE().notice: Maximum USDC hourly rate (1,000 USDC, 6-decimal units).

MAX_SHIFT_SECONDS().notice: Maximum shift duration in seconds (24 hours).

attest(uint256,uint32).notice: Employer attests worked seconds; accepts Funded, Active, or AwaitingAttestation.

cancel(uint256).notice: Employer cancels a shift that has never been clocked in; full refund.

claim(uint256).notice: Worker claims their attested pay; moves to Claimed or Settled.

clockIn(uint256).notice: Worker clocks in; moves shift from Funded to Active.

clockOut(uint256).notice: Worker clocks out; moves shift from Active to AwaitingAttestation.

createShift(address,uint256,uint32).notice: Create a new shift and pull escrow from the caller.

getShift(uint256).notice: Return a single shift. Unknown IDs return a zero-valued struct with status None.

getShifts(uint256[]).notice: Return multiple shifts. At most 50 IDs per call.

nextShiftId().notice: Next shift ID to be assigned; starts at 1 (0 is invalid).

refundUnused(uint256).notice: Permissionless: return escrow in excess of owed back to the employer.         Accepts Attested (before claim) or Claimed (after claim); always pays employer.

totalEscrow().notice: Sum of escrow across all open (non-terminal) shifts.

usdc().notice: The USDC ERC-20 token used for all escrow.
